clues.text: On Mount Sinai, God gave Moses two of these, inscribed by His own finger.
Moses carried two of these down the mountain, and they were written on both sides, front and back.
When Moses saw the golden calf and the dancing, he threw these down and shattered them at the mountain's base.
After Moses broke the first ones, God told him to chisel out two new ones like the originals.
In Solomon's temple, the ark of the covenant held nothing but these, which Moses had placed there at Horeb.
God told the prophet Habakkuk to write the vision clearly on these, so a herald could run with it.
Paul told the Corinthians they were a letter from Christ, written not on stone ones but on human hearts.
